seo.title: Privacy Policy | Divinely Faded
seo.description: How Divinely Faded LLC in Carlsbad, NM handles your information when you visit this site, text or chat with the shop, book on Booksy, pay or review us.

_legal.source: DG legal kit 2026-10-27, revised 2026-11-05: legal entity (Divinely Faded LLC, NM), several barbers, Google chat from the Business Profile (the Google messaging agent lists this URL as its privacy policy), Booksy prepayments, in-shop payment providers, public reviews shown on the site, texts and chats section, Do Not Track note. Inventory re-checked 2026-11-05 over all 220 built pages: no forms, no analytics or ad tags, no first-party cookies or storage; third parties = Vercel hosting + Vercel Blob photos, Google Fonts, Google Maps embeds (8 pages), TikTok player on tap (homepage EN/ES), one Booksy-hosted photo on the homepage. Template-grade, not attorney-reviewed.
_legal.how_to_replace: Edit this file and rebuild (node tools/build.mjs --today <date>). Update the 'Last updated' line and the 'updated' field together. Re-run the third-party inventory (scripts, iframes, fonts, forms, storage) before changing what the policy says. Any analytics, ad tag, SMS program or new form must be added here in the same PR that turns it on.

paragraphs: This policy explains what information Divinely Faded LLC collects when you use divinelyfaded.com, text or chat with the shop, book on Booksy, pay for a service or leave a review, how we use it, and the choices you have.
Last updated: November 5, 2026.

blocks.heading: Who we are.
paragraphs: Divinely Faded LLC is a New Mexico limited liability company that runs Divinely Faded, the barbershop at {{address}}. In this policy, “we,” “us” and “our” mean Divinely Faded LLC, its owner Tim Murillo and the barbers who work at the shop.
To reach us about anything in this policy, text or call {{phone}}.

blocks.heading: Information we collect.
blocks.lead: This website has no forms, no accounts and no logins. Here is everything we receive, and where it comes from.
paragraphs: Texts and calls. If you text or call the shop, we receive your phone number, your name if you give it, and whatever you write or say.

Chats through Google. If you message us from a chat button on our Business Profile in Google Search or Google Maps, Google delivers the conversation to us. We see what you write, the name Google shows us for your account, and the time. Google handles the chat under its own privacy policy.

Bookings. Appointments are made on Booksy, a separate booking service. Booksy collects the details you enter there, such as your name, phone number, email and the service you pick, and shares your booking with us. If a service asks for a prepayment, Booksy and its payment processor handle your card. We never see your full card number.

Payments at the shop. When you pay by card, Zelle or Cash App, the payment runs through the provider you chose, under its own policy. We keep the transaction record, such as the amount, date and service, for our books.

Reviews. If you review us on Google or Booksy, your review is public on that platform under its rules. We may reply publicly, and we may show a review on this site with the name and service shown on the platform.

Technical details. When you load a page, the servers that deliver it automatically receive basic information such as your IP address, browser and device type, the page you asked for and the time. This happens through our hosting provider and the outside services listed below.
We do not run analytics or advertising tools on this website. That means no Google Analytics, no tag manager and no ad pixels. If that changes, we will update this policy before it does.

blocks.heading: How we use it.
blocks.lead: We use information only to run the shop and this site. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for targeted advertising.
bullets: To answer your texts, calls and chats.
To schedule, confirm or change your appointment and to give you the service you booked.
To take payment and keep the business records the law expects us to keep.
To reply to reviews and to show a few of them on this site.
To keep this website running, secure and working the way it should.
To follow the law and protect our rights.

blocks.heading: Who we share it with.
blocks.lead: A few outside companies help run this site and the shop. Each handles information under its own privacy policy.
paragraphs: Hosting: Vercel hosts this website and stores some of its photos and videos. Its servers receive the technical details described above. Vercel privacy notice.

Booking and prepayments: Booksy runs our online booking, shows our booking and cancellation policies, sends appointment reminders and, with its payment processor, handles any prepayment. One photo on our homepage also loads from Booksy. Booksy privacy policy.
Payments at the shop: your card’s network and processor, Zelle or Cash App handle the payment you choose to make, under their own policies.

Google: Google Fonts delivers the typefaces on every page. The Visit page and the Artesia, Hobbs and Roswell pages show an embedded Google Map, and our directions links open Google Maps. If you chat with us from Google Search or Maps, Google carries the conversation. Google privacy policy.
Videos: The homepage shows previews of our TikTok videos. TikTok’s player loads only if you tap a video. TikTok privacy policy.
Social media: Links to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube take you to those sites, where their own policies apply.

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information. We share it only with the companies above, when the law requires it, to protect anyone’s rights or safety, or as part of a sale or transfer of the business.

blocks.heading: Cookies and tracking.
paragraphs: This website does not set its own cookies and stores nothing on your device. Outside services can set their own cookies when their content loads in your browser: Google when an embedded map loads, TikTok after you tap a video, and Booksy on its own site.
You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. To control how Google uses your data for ads, visit Google Ad Settings.
Because we do not track you across sites, a “Do Not Track” or Global Privacy Control signal from your browser changes nothing here: there is no tracking to turn off.

blocks.heading: Texts and chats.
paragraphs: Divinely Faded texts or chats only to answer you or about your appointment, so how often you hear from us depends on the conversation. We do not run a marketing text program. Booksy sends its own appointment reminders, which you control in your Booksy settings.

To stop hearing from us, reply STOP to any text from us, or block the number. In a Google chat, you can block or report the conversation with Google’s controls, or just tell us to stop. For help, reply HELP, text or call {{phone}}. Your carrier’s standard message and data rates may apply.
Conversations through Google chat are kept only to answer you and for our records. We do not sell, rent or share their contents with anyone except the service that delivers them to us.

blocks.heading: Retention and security.
paragraphs: We keep texts, chats, call history, booking details and payment records only as long as we need them to serve you, keep normal business records and meet legal duties. Booksy, Google and our hosting provider keep their records under their own policies.

We take reasonable steps to protect the information we receive, and every page of this site is served over a secure HTTPS connection. No way of sending or storing information is completely secure, so we cannot promise perfect security.

blocks.heading: Your choices and rights.
paragraphs: You can ask what personal information we have about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. Just text or call {{phone}}. We may need to confirm who you are first, we will respond to every request, and we will not treat you differently for asking.

Residents of California and some other states may have more rights under their state’s law. We will honor the requests that apply to us. To change or close a Booksy account, use your Booksy settings or contact Booksy.

blocks.heading: Children.
paragraphs: This website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them through it. Kids’ appointments are booked by a parent or guardian. If you think a child under 13 has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

blocks.heading: Changes and contact.
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the date at the top of this page.
Questions? Reach us at {{phone}} by text or phone, or stop by the shop at {{address}} during open hours. Our Terms & Conditions cover appointments, cancellations and payment.
